• 5000 Nalanda–Rajgir 3-Day Tour | Glass Bridge, Ropeway & Budget Guide.
Planning a trip to Nalanda and Rajgir? This is the ONLY guide you need! We did the 2-day tour and share the complete budget, transport tips, and must-see places.
Day 1 Highlights: Nalanda University Ruins, Pawapuri Jal Mandir, Hiuen Tsang Memorial Hall, Mahavira's Birthplace.
Day 2 Highlights: Rajgir Tanga ride, Jarasand Akhara, Rath Chakra Chinha (Lord Krishna's Chariot marks!), Bimbisar Jail, Vishwa Shanti Stupa (Ropeway), Ghoda Katora Lake, Garam Kund.
